name: Ivybolt · Gremlet #47
description:
A tall machine so wrapped in ivy that only its eyes peek out. It moves slowly so the leaves don't fall.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Ivybolt in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
